verdict.rationale: All installation evidence describes human-run commands (`/plugin marketplace add`, `devin plugins install`, git clone steps) that differ per harness and are documented as manual steps a user performs, not a single headless, promptless path the agent runs itself end-to-end. Community commentary even notes the install mechanism is 'curl|bash but with added LLM agents,' underscoring it's not a clean self-serve agent install. No evidence shows an agent autonomously invoking these install commands without human initiation.
